displayName: NoETL EHDB: tier diverged from the authoritative event log

conditions.displayName: NoETL EHDB: tier diverged from the authoritative event log

documentation.content: The cross-store comparator found the EHDB event-log tier disagreeing with the authoritative `noetl.event` log. While the tier is `primary` this is a correctness signal about a store that is actively being served. KNOWN OPEN AT CREATION (2026-08-13): every hourly `system/scheduled_cleanup` execution mirrors 11 of 13 events — the two missing are both `command.claimed`. User-pool executions are clean (29/29). So this alert is EXPECTED to be firing until that is fixed; do not treat an initial firing as a false positive. Ref noetl/ai-meta#257, noetl/ai-meta#258.
